body_lead: Four firms will hire candidates, complementing the 100 offers announced at the launch. Hyderabad:Telangana on Thursday launched the Green Skills & Applied AI Centre of Excellence at SAS iTower, announcing 100 job offers through 1M1B Jobs Express. Set up by the IT, industries and commerce department in partnership with Microsoft, 1M1B and the MeitY Startup Hub, the Centre will train graduates in applied AI, green pharma, solar energy, electric vehicles and wind energy.
